assertions.assertion: Problem statement names what decides the right payment (litres with unit converted, co-op rate, month by dairy local time) and says paid/stated amount can differ, checkable on one pickup or farm-month
assertions.evidence: The write-up has no separate problem statement. It opens with "Both complaints are correct, and each one has a separate cause in milk.py" and goes straight to code causes. The deciding rules (convert gal by 3.785, ×0.42, month at the dairy in UTC-7) appear only inside those cause explanations and the fix list, not as a general statement of what decides the right amount.

assertions.assertion: The problem statement does not build in a cause or a fix
assertions.evidence: The framing is the causes themselves: "pickup_payment … never reads the unit column" and "month_of takes the first 7 characters of the UTC timestamp". The fixes "Convert gal to litres by 3.785" and "Convert to UTC-7" also appear. No cause-free statement stands apart from this evidence.

assertions.assertion: Both complaints fit the statement and it is falsifiable
assertions.evidence: Both complaints are covered, under the headings "F-07, pickup P-8835: paid 33.60, should be 127.18" and "F-12, September statement: 367.50, should be 480.90". Each claim names a concrete right amount that recomputing the pickup or the farm's month could refute.
